description: This file defines serialization and deserialization logic for PyTorch's FX graph-based models, including classes and functions for exporting, handling tensor metadata, symbolic shape representations, and operator handling. It is part of the PyTorch torch._export module, specifically for serializing models for export purposes.

classes.name: SerializedArtifact
classes.description: Dataclass to hold serialized artifacts including exported program, state_dict, constants, and example inputs.

classes.name: _SerializedProgram
classes.description: Dataclass holding components of a serialized program, similar to SerializedArtifact.

classes.name: LazyMap
classes.description: A dictionary class for deferred instantiation of node metadata values, to avoid premature symbolic tensor creation.

classes.name: GraphState
classes.description: Dataclass capturing the state of a graph during serialization, including inputs, outputs, nodes, tensor and shape info, and custom objects.

classes.name: Final
classes.description: Metaclass to enforce final class semantics, preventing subclassing.

classes.name: GraphModuleSerializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for serializing a Torch FX graph into a form suitable for exporting, including handling nodes, inputs, outputs, and operator serialization.

methods.name: torch.device deserialize_device(d: Device)

methods.name: deserialize_size
methods.description: Converts a list of SymInt representing tensor sizes into a tuple of ints.

methods.name: deserialize_stride
methods.description: Converts a list of SymInt representing tensor strides into a tuple of ints.

methods.name: deserialize_scalar_type
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType enum to a torch.dtype.

methods.name: deserialize_storage_offset
methods.description: Converts a SymInt storage offset to an int.

methods.description: Returns the repr string of a sympy.Expr, torch.SymInt, etc.

methods.description: Serializes a SymInt from int or torch.SymInt into the SymInt protobuf representation.

methods.name: serialize_sym_float
methods.description: Serializes a SymFloat from float or torch.SymFloat into the SymFloat protobuf representation.

methods.name: serialize_sym_bool

methods.description: Extracts a TensorMeta object describing a torch.Tensor.

methods.description: Helper to reduce a FakeTensor for pickling, returning reconstruction function and args.

methods.name: FakeTensor _reconstruct_fake_tensor( serialized_tensor_meta: bytes, is_parameter: bool )
methods.description: Reconstructs a FakeTensor from serialized metadata.

methods.name: serialize_torch_artifact
methods.description: Serializes an artifact (like tensors, modules) into bytes for storage or transmission.

methods.description: Converts an int into a sympy.Integer or special symbol for symbolic expressions.

methods.name: serialize_range_constraints

methods.name: save_graph_state
methods.description: Context manager to reset and restore the internal graph state during serialization.

methods.description: Handles FX placeholder nodes, serializing inputs appropriately.

methods.name: handle_output
methods.description: Handles FX output nodes, serializing model outputs.

methods.description: Handles FX call_function nodes, serializing calls and relevant metadata.

methods.name: handle_get_attr
methods.description: Handles FX get_attr nodes (currently a stub).

methods.name: Optional[torch.fx.Node] _output_node_at_index(self, node, index)
methods.description: Finds the FX node that outputs a particular index of a getitem node.

methods.name: serialize_metadata

methods.name: serialize_script_obj_meta
methods.description: Serializes custom ScriptObject data.

methods.description: Serializes symbolic operator inputs.

methods.name: serialize_inputs

methods.description: Serializes inputs for higher-order operators, which lack schema.

methods.name: is_inductor_sym_int_arg
methods.description: Checks if argument is a SymInt type for inductor-specific handling.

methods.name: is_sym_int_arg
methods.description: Checks if argument is a SymInt or fx.Node that corresponds to one.

methods.name: is_sym_float_arg
methods.description: Checks if argument is a SymFloat or fx.Node.

methods.name: is_sym_bool_arg
methods.description: Checks if argument is a SymBool or fx.Node.

methods.name: serialize_input
methods.description: Serializes a single input argument, handling types like tensors, ints, floats, symbolic shapes, constants, lists, dicts, etc.

methods.name: serialize_tensor_output
methods.description: Serializes tensor output metadata and registers in graph state.

methods.name: serialize_sym_int_output
methods.description: Serializes SymInt output metadata.

methods.name: serialize_sym_float_output
methods.description: Serializes SymFloat output metadata.

methods.name: serialize_sym_bool_output
methods.description: Serializes SymBool output metadata.

methods.name: serialize_input_spec
methods.description: Serializes input specifications for export, handling constant, tensor, buffer, custom, token, and optional types.

methods.name: serialize_output_spec
methods.description: Serializes output specifications, including user outputs, loss outputs, and mutations.

methods.name: serialize_signature
methods.description: Serializes a graph signature into its protobuf representation.

methods.name: serialize_argument_spec
methods.description: Converts an ep.ArgumentSpec into its protobuf Argument form.

methods.name: serialize_treespec
methods.description: Serializes a pytree.TreeSpec into a string and saves namedtuple fields info.

methods.name: serialize_module_call_signature
methods.description: Serializes a module call signature to protobuf.

methods.name: serialize_module_call_graph
methods.description: Serializes a list of module call entries.

methods.name: serialize_outputs
methods.description: Serializes node outputs into Arguments, handling multiple and aggregate returns to match FX pattern.

methods.name: serialize_hoo_outputs
methods.description: Serializes HOO outputs, which lack schema, including lists and dict outputs.

methods.name: serialize_output
methods.description: Serializes a single return value to Argument, covering tensor, symbolic, and None types.

methods.name: list[TensorArgument] _handle_getitem_users(self, node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Generates getitem nodes for outputs in FX if needed, mapping FX output nodes to names.

methods.name: serialize_graph
methods.description: Serializes an entire torch.fx.GraphModule into custom Graph protobuf, handling nodes, inputs, outputs, and metadata.

methods.description: Main method of GraphModuleSerializer to serialize a torch.fx.GraphModule into a Graph protobuf object.

methods.description: Serializes range constraints from exported program.
